comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind the recovery base to the cycle execution base**

When `cycleBaseSha` and `recovery.base_sha` are two different commits that each independently descend from the frozen plan base through allowlisted ledger/review-only history, both compatibility checks pass. The pre-push and delivery-reconcile callers can therefore accept a recovery record for a different execution base than the cycle being delivered, despite their contract requiring identity-mismatched evidence to fail closed. Require the recovery base to equal the non-null cycle base, then verify that single execution base against the original plan base.
